title: Downsampler
text: Downsample by removing data samples between input samples, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Downsample factor (K)} sets the downsampling factor, {Sample offset (0 to K-1)} and {Enable reset input port} sets the option to enable reset input port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Downsample factor (K)
params.values: Downsampling factor 2 (default) | integer in the range [1, 2.^16]

params.name: Sample offset (0 to K-1)
params.values: Sample offset 0 (default) | integer in the range [0, 2.^16 – 1]

params.name: Enable reset input port
params.values: Option to enable reset input port off (default) | on
